adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#21
adds.text: Talbot's soldiers detain Coulson and his team at the ruined Playground. Coulson tries to explain, and when Aida attacks, Talbot reluctantly lets them fly off.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Uneasy friend Talbot detains at the ruined base, then lets go.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Uneasy friend who detains Coulson's team, then lets them fly off.
adds.evidence: The Return (S4#21): Talbot arrives at the ruined base; Simmons, Coulson, May and Daisy are stopped by Talbot's Air Force soldiers; Coulson tries to explain; Talbot reluctantly lets the agents go. In S4#22 he also calls Coulson to explain himself to the inquiry.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#21
adds.text: Talbot's soldiers detain May with Coulson and the team at the ruined Playground, then Talbot lets them fly off as Aida attacks.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Agent Talbot detains at the ruined base, then lets go.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: General who detains May's team at the ruined base, then lets them go.
adds.evidence: The Return (S4#21): May, Simmons and Coulson are arrested by Talbot's soldiers at the destroyed Playground; Fitz has May fly the Zephyr away and Talbot lets the agents go. Talbot now calls S.H.I.E.L.D. fugitives, so rival rather than ally.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#3
adds.text: Jemma and Radcliffe cure May of the ghost's madness by stopping her heart and bringing her back.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A close friend Jemma cures of a ghost's madness.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A close friend who cures May of a ghost's madness.
adds.evidence: Uprising (S4#3): Radcliffe and Simmons cure May of Lucy Bauer's infection by killing and reviving her. The S6#13 stage already refers back to this cure.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#12
adds.text: Jemma realizes the May beside Coulson is a decoy and warns Daisy in time to stop it from killing him.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Jemma's commander, whom she saves from a May decoy.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: One of Coulson's closest agents, who saves him from a May decoy.
adds.evidence: Hot Potato Soup (S4#12): Simmons remembers Radcliffe scanned May's brain and warns Daisy of the May LMD in time to stop it from taking the Darkhold and killing Coulson. Coulson runs operations again after S4#10, so the boss through-line holds.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#21
adds.text: Fitz escapes Aida at the ruined Playground and urges May to fly the Zephyr away before Aida catches them.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: An old friend Fitz urges to fly the team away from Aida.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: An old friend who urges May to fly the team away from Aida.
adds.evidence: The Return (S4#21): fleeing Aida with Piper, Fitz reaches the standoff with Talbot and insists May fly Zephyr One away before Aida finds them. Earlier in S4#20 Ophelia confronts Coulson, May and Fitz on Ivanov's platform.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#7
adds.text: Coulson and Fitz are trapped together between dimensions, watching helplessly as Morrow kills agents, until Aida opens a portal that brings them home.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Fitz's friend, trapped beside him between dimensions.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A loyal friend trapped with Coulson between dimensions.
adds.evidence: Deals with Our Devils (S4#7): Coulson, Fitz and Reyes are trapped between dimensions and watch Morrow kill agents; Aida builds a portal through which Coulson and Fitz return.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#22
adds.text: Coulson sends Piper off the Zephyr by parachute with orders to tell the team's story if things go wrong.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: An agent Coulson sends off with orders to tell their story.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Piper's director, who sends her off to tell the team's story.
adds.evidence: World's End (S4#22): Piper leaves Zephyr One by parachute with instructions in case things go wrong with Aida; in S5#11 she says she followed Coulson's orders and told their story.

none.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
none.why: Talbot appears only in S4#21 and S4#22. In S4#21 Fitz runs into the team's standoff with Talbot and tells May to fly off, but sources show no exchange between Fitz and Talbot; in S4#22 Fitz is not at the inquiry where Talbot is shot.

none.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
none.why: Mack is inside the Framework for both of Talbot's S4 appearances (S4#21, S4#22) and only returns after Talbot is shot at the inquiry.

none.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
none.why: In S4#21 Elena is aboard the Zephyr and plugs herself into the Framework; in S4#22 she is in the Framework with Mack. Talbot never deals with her in S4.

owner_calls.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
owner_calls.question: In S4#21 Fitz arrives at the standoff between Talbot and the team, warns that Aida is coming and has May fly off while Talbot lets them go. Does sharing that standoff count as Talbot and Fitz dealing with each other?
options: Add rival S4#21: Fitz bursts into Talbot's standoff with the team, and Talbot lets them fly off as Aida attacks
owner_calls.evidence: Piper page (The Return): 'Finding all the other S.H.I.E.L.D. agents in a standoff with Glenn Talbot, Fitz insisted that Melinda May fly Zephyr One away... Talbot retreated as they flew away.'
